title: Aureline voice transcript retention and export controls
description: Versioned, export-safe transcript-retention and export control object for a voice provider path. Pins the retention mode, the audio-retention class, and the transcript-export posture, declares whether the user can change them, and carries a redaction-aware disclosure label. Raw transcripts are excluded from support/telemetry by default and any support export is redacted first. Raw audio, raw transcripts, raw provider payloads, private paths, and credentials never cross this boundary; the object carries only typed class tokens, booleans, and redaction-aware labels. This is the control object that voice provider routing resolves an active copy of when switching provider, locality, or language profile, so switching never hides a retention or export change.

user_changeable.description: Whether the user can change these controls in this context (false for enterprise-managed, locked, or blocked states).

raw_transcripts_excluded_by_default.description: Whether raw transcripts are excluded from support/telemetry by default. Must be true.

redaction_before_support_export.description: Whether transcripts are redacted before any support export.

disclosure_label.description: Export-safe disclosure summary shown alongside the controls.
